name.zh-CN: 机械零件需求解析；语义拓扑角色及来源诊断
name.en: Mechanical Part Analysis; Semantic Topology Provenance

description: Extract explicit dimensions and intent for generic Sketch/Revolve and Extrude operations, axis references, simple/counterbore/countersink holes, linear/circular/explicit placement patterns, R-radius Fillets, and C-distance Chamfers; identify semantic source topology and report missing or ambiguous information without guessing. and fixed-section planar Sweep paths; capture explicit section dimensions, ordered Line/Arc endpoints, path radius, and start-frame requirements without guessing. Analyse Loft requests as ordered existing Sketch sections. Confirm every section plane, offset, profile size/center, one-to-one curve correspondence, RULED mode, operation, and aligned orientation from the user's request; ask when critical values are missing and never infer a section. G7C: reference generated topology only within fixed-binormal planar Line/Arc Sweeps and aligned ruled Lofts; Hole uses caps only, while Fillet/Chamfer uses an explicit intersection of generated face roles. Preserve source Feature, role, and Sketch entity/adjacent ordered-section IDs; never persist OCP Face/Edge ordinals. Re-resolve with tolerances after rebuild and fail closed on zero or multiple matches.
execution_steps: Scan explicit dimension and technical-requirement evidence
Compare labelled repeated values for conflicts
Mark uncertain and unsupported requirements without translating them into geometry
Classify simple, counterbore, and countersink holes separately; record support face, axis direction, through/blind termination, and seed pattern dimensions
For every requested R/C edge treatment, preserve the source feature and stable sketch entity, hole end, pocket entrance, or adjacent semantic faces; distinguish a hole-mouth Chamfer from Countersink.

For a revolved shape, record the axial section profile, axis direction and datum definition, ADD/CUT intent, full or partial angle, orientation, and any outer/inner loops as separate explicit evidence.

For Countersink requests, preserve the explicit mouth diameter and included angle separately from the main Hole diameter; if either is absent, ask instead of choosing a conventional angle. Keep Countersink distinct from Counterbore and edge Chamfer.

For nonuniform listed hole or cut locations, preserve each target position and its reference plane as an ExplicitPlacementPattern candidate; preserve PCD/count/start-angle intent as CircularPattern and uniform direction/spacing intent as LinearPattern.

For a Sweep request, record profile type and dimensions, each ordered planar Line/Arc segment, path radius and endpoints, ADD/CUT intent, directed start anchor, and fixed-binormal frame; mark any missing value AMBIGUOUS or MISSING.
Map explicit Loft requirements to section Sketch identities, dimensions, plane offsets and operation; record missing values as AMBIGUOUS or MISSING rather than inventing them.
For a generated Sweep/Loft reference, capture the source Feature, semantic face role, Sketch entity identity, or adjacent ordered Loft section pair from the EngineeringModel.
validation_gates: Every reported explicit value has an input span
Derived values come only from the validated EngineeringModel context
No missing engineering value is inferred
Countersink angle and mouth diameter remain explicit; unsupported geometry is never silently converted to another hole type
Never represent Edge7 or an OCP edge index as engineering intent; preserve edge selection ambiguity for deterministic kernel resolution.
Do not infer a missing rotation axis, profile closure, radius, angle, or inner loop; mark an axis-crossing or unsupported profile as ambiguous/unsupported until its actual geometry is validated.
Never derive a Countersink angle or mouth diameter from a standard-size assumption; only derive conical depth from validated mouth diameter, main bore diameter, and included angle.
Explicit placement coordinates require their declared principal/Datum reference plane and are not assumed to be world XY.
Never infer a Sweep path radius, endpoint, section size, or orientation; sharp-corner joins, self-intersections, closed paths, variable sections, twist, and arbitrary 3D paths are unsupported.
Any Loft claim requires actual ordered section references and the validated current EngineeringModel rebuild; never infer unsupported topology or hidden section size.
Generated face and edge roles re-resolve against current source geometry with explicit tolerances; zero or multiple matches fail closed, with no persisted OCP ordinals.
failure_policy: On stale, missing, ambiguous, or unsupported topology, preserve the original error code and stop; never retarget by face/edge order.
G7C：在固定 binormal 的平面 Line/Arc Sweep 与 aligned ruled Loft 范围内引用生成拓扑；Hole 仅使用端盖，Fillet/Chamfer 使用明确的生成面交线。所有引用保留来源 Feature、角色及草图实体/相邻有序截面 ID，不保存 OCP Face/Edge 编号；上游重建后按公差重解析，零匹配或多匹配必须失败关闭。
